title: Xavier Clark's "PLAYER" is an amazing piece of work
htmlContent:
Xavier Clark's "PLAYER" is an amazing piece of work that is everything artistry should be. He goes against the grain, and uses his power of being an artist to command the minds with substance, as well as something real to get you through. The passion and aggression in the flow is prominent, as you hear the fire in his heart being released unto the mic.
